summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for SoldierCalculator, EquipmentTables and TroveCollectionTable across TR, EN, DE, KO, AR (+spot-checked RU/FR/ES via i18n file). All three components fully translate strings; tier buttons (T11/T8/T7/T6) and Trove type buttons (UNCOMMON/RARE/EXOTIC-T1..T3) intentionally remain untranslated per spec; no raw i18n keys leak into the UI. Verified logged-in Save button label 'Calculate & Save' (EN) and 'CALCULATION HISTORY' header render correctly after a save. Found and fixed one i18n key naming inconsistency that caused the sidebar 'Asker Eğitim' entry to never translate.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar entry for mh_asker_egitim was rendered as literal Turkish 'Asker Eğitim' in every language because Commanders.jsx looks up t(`cat_${c.key}`) => `cat_mh_asker_egitim`, but the i18n bundle defined it under `cat_asker_egitim` (missing `mh_` prefix). Other mh_* categories used the correct `cat_mh_*` naming and worked. FIXED by renaming the key across all 8 locales.

action_items: None blocking. Sidebar i18n key rename already applied by test agent. Main agent should confirm the rename is acceptable and keep the naming convention consistent (cat_mh_* for HESAPLA subcategories).
critical_code_review_comments: i18n key naming convention drift: 7 of 8 HESAPLA categories used `cat_mh_<slug>` while `asker_egitim` alone used `cat_<slug>`. Prefer a single source of truth (e.g., map c.key -> translation key) or an ESLint check to prevent future drift.
SoldierCalculator Save button/history are auth-gated (canEdit); anonymous users cannot verify these strings. Not a bug, just noted for future test coverage.

Sidebar section header BILGILENDIRME/HESAPLA/etc. are translated via SIDEBAR_SECTION_I18N map, but the section-toggle data-testid still contains the raw Turkish key ('section-toggle-MALİYET HESAPLAMA'). Fine for tests but slightly leaks TR into the DOM attribute space.
seed_data_creation: One calculation saved via admin during Save button verification (TEST cleanup not required, dev data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n coverage across 8 languages for SoldierCalculator/EquipmentTables/TroveCollectionTable verified. Category sidebar key convention is now uniformly cat_mh_<slug>. If more categories are added, ensure the same convention. Auth-gated UI (Save button, history table) requires admin login (admin/admin123) to see full translations.
